Michael Ford Founder of HumanCore Innovations · Helping people find compassion sooner
About
Support should meet people where they are. My path began with childhood hardship — losing my mother at 13, experiencing homelessness. Those years taught me two things: how much the right support at the right moment matters, and how hard that support can be to find. Today, I am the Founder of HumanCore Innovations and creator of MindSwift — a privacy-first, AI-powered emotional support and resource platform designed to meet people where they are. Here is what that means in practice: • Private by design. Supportive conversations are processed on your device. No accounts, no subscriptions, no selling user data. • Support that listens first. Real conversations, not scripted menus — for emotional support, calm daily check-ins, and encouragement. • Help that is actually nearby. Location-aware connections to trusted community resources: crisis navigation, reentry and second-chance support, youth services, veterans resources, accessibility tools, and domestic violence safety. • Built for real life. Voice-first and hands-free, with accessibility at the core — because the people who need support most often face the most barriers. MindSwift is free, self-funded, and built by an independent founder-developer in Akron, Ohio. It is in closed beta on Google Play now. What guides this work is one belief: Technology should never replace compassion. It should help people find it sooner. WHO I WORK WITH: Healthcare systems, schools, employers, nonprofits, veterans services, faith communities, government agencies, and reentry programs exploring responsible AI — tools that complement the professionals already doing this work, never replace them. I also speak and lead workshops on democratizing AI, privacy-first technology, and building human-centered tools — for keynotes, classrooms, boardrooms, and youth summits. If your organization is exploring AI initiatives and wants solutions that are practical, responsible, and centered on real human needs, I would welcome the opportunity to connect. Message me here on LinkedIn — or start with MindSwift at humancoreinno.com.
Fits the 2,600-character limit as-is.
FAQ

Good questions.

Is this really free?

Yes. No invoice, no catch. Think of it as a sample of my work — you keep everything either way.

Why me?

I rebuild LinkedIn profiles for founders and builders. Your mission was one clear line away from a profile that tells it — so I wrote that line.

Can I edit your copy?

Please do. It's a starting point — your voice is the final judge.

What if I don't like it?

Keep the parts you like, skip the rest. No hard feelings — the files are still yours.

How do I get all this onto my profile?

Every section has a copy button — copy, paste into LinkedIn, done. Your banner and photo files arrive by email at full size, ready to upload.
